<parameter=text>
Recent studies suggest that the QuickVax vaccine for the NovaFlu virus is approximately 70% effective in preventing illness in adults 50 years and older. Among those with pre-existing conditions such as diabetes and heart disease, the efficacy rate drops slightly to 65%. The vaccine has not yet been approved for use in children under the age of 12.
</parameter>
